description: This file contains unit tests for the ImmutableAcknowledgement class within the Eclipse Ditto project. It tests creation, immutability, JSON serialization, status code interpretation, and behavior of acknowledgements involving entity IDs and headers.

classes.name: ImmutableAcknowledgementTest
classes.description: Unit test suite for the ImmutableAcknowledgement class, verifying its behavior, immutability, JSON serialization, and status interpretation.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes DittoHeaders with a dynamic correlation ID based on the test method name.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that ImmutableAcknowledgement and its components are immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies the equals and hashCode contract for ImmutableAcknowledgement.

methods.name: tryToGetInstanceWithNullAcknowledgementLabel
methods.description: Tests that passing null for label throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToGetInstanceWithNullEntityId
methods.description: Tests that passing null for entityId throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToGetInstanceWithNullStatusCode
methods.description: Tests that passing null for statusCode throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToGetInstanceWithNullDittoHeaders
methods.description: Tests that passing null for dittoHeaders throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: toJsonWithoutEntityReturnsExpected
methods.description: Ensures JSON serialization without payload is correct.

methods.name: toJsonWithEntityReturnsExpected
methods.description: Ensures JSON serialization with payload is correct.

methods.name: getLabelReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that getLabel returns the correct label.

methods.name: getEntityIdReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that getEntityId returns the correct entity ID.

methods.name: acknowledgementWithStatusCodeNotFoundIsNotSuccess
methods.description: Checks that a 404 status code is interpreted as not a success.

methods.name: acknowledgementWithStatusCodeOkIsSuccess
methods.description: Checks that a 200 status code is interpreted as a success.

methods.name: liveResponseAcknowledgementWithNonTimeoutIsSuccess
methods.description: Verifies that live response acknowledgements with non-timeout codes are successful.

methods.name: liveResponseAcknowledgementWithTimeoutIsFailed
methods.description: Verifies that live response acknowledgements with a timeout status are not successful.

methods.name: acknowledgementWithStatusCodeOkIsNotTimeout
methods.description: Checks that an OK status does not mark the acknowledgement as a timeout.

methods.name: acknowledgementWithStatusCodeRequestTimeoutIsTimeout
methods.description: Checks that a REQUEST_TIMEOUT status marks the acknowledgement as timeout.

methods.name: getStatusCodeReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that getStatusCode returns the correct status code.

methods.name: getExistingEntity
methods.description: Tests retrieval of an existing entity/payload.

methods.name: getMissingEntity
methods.description: Tests behavior when no entity payload is set.

methods.name: getDittoHeadersReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies the retrieved DittoHeaders object.

methods.name: responseRequiredIsSetToFalse
methods.description: Confirms that responseRequired flag is false when set as such.

methods.name: setDittoHeadersWorksAsExpected
methods.description: Tests that updating headers produces a new acknowledgement with the correct headers.

methods.name: getEntityTypeReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that getEntityType returns the expected entity type.

methods.name: getTypeReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks that getType returns the correct string representation of the entity type.
